content.text:
**My answer:** Clal (כלל). It's 0.48% "מהחיסכון", the cheapest S&P 500 keren hishtalmut on the list. I'm fairly sure. What settled it was the line above the table: "12 מסלולים של 12 חברות… דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.48% עד 0.7%", plus "מסודרים… מהיקר לזול". So I knew the cheap one would be at the bottom, and the second-to-last row was Clal at 0.48%. Menora is right behind at 0.49%, basically the same, and it's a name I know too.

**How it went:**
- **First screen.** The heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות". The "קרן השתלמות 154" and "עוקב מדד S&P 500 12" buttons were already lit up, which was exactly what I wanted. Then I read the summary line with 0.48% to 0.7%.
- **Scrolling down.** I only looked at the fee column, which goes 0.7%, 0.68%, 0.66%… down to 0.49% for Menora and 0.48% for Clal. I didn't look at the returns or the managed money at all.
- **Last row.** Ayalon Kupot Gemel (איילון קופות גמל) has "עוד לא דווח" with an orange warning sign, "חדש", and only 40% stocks. That scared me off it, so I ignored it.
- **Skipped:** the grey notes at the bottom (PF-06, "התשואה היא תשואת עבר…"), the "מה זה קרן השתלמות" link, the search box and the footer.

**Where I hesitated:**
- Under every fund it says "אין מההפקדות". It's the same on every row, so I had to read it again each time to get to what's actually different. It sounds like something is missing, and I didn't really get it.
- The ring charts with "מניות" and "מט"ח" next to them. I don't know what מט"ח means. Some show 101%, which is weird. The green and yellow dots I guessed are stocks and foreign currency.
- The page says it's sorted "מהיקר לזול", but the bottom row has no fee at all. That confused me for a second.
- On some rows the return just says "פחות מ־3 שנים" instead of a number.

**What bothered me:** "דמי ניהול" is shown only as a percent, never in shekels, so I can't feel the difference between 0.48% and 0.7%. And the same "אין מההפקדות" line repeated on every row.
